note: REVIEW-NIGHT-2 U-06 (owner 2026-10-26 02:53: "Your own regex settings have no timeout - let's add"): the user's own patterns (secret_extra_rules HARD/WARN, prod_patterns, ticket_pattern, relaunch_allow, deny_class_patterns, and protected_branches globs that mix * and **) run in a forked child the helper kills at a wall-clock limit (lib/userre.pm). A stopped one takes its setting's safe side (a secret rule withholds, a production pattern or a protected branch counts as a match, a ticket pattern gives no ticket, a relaunch_allow or deny_class_patterns entry does not match), writes one regex_timeout {key, index, why} row and gets a /status warning; NAME globs and the other protected_branches globs compile to regexes that cannot backtrack (same answers as the plain translation). Each lib check runs in a child the runner kills after 20 s, so code without the bound ((a+)+$ on 100 KB of a then b backtracks for minutes) fails as hung; the CLI steps have a 20 s step timeout and a time ceiling.

steps.name: prod_patterns: a stopped pattern is production, not run again
prod_patterns: normal input, answers and overhead
secret_extra_rules: normal input, same hits and redaction
ticket_pattern: a stopped pattern gives no ticket
relaunch_allow: a stopped pattern does not allowlist
protected_branches: a stopped mixed glob protects
the process budget: later patterns take the safe side unrun
no orphan: the pattern child ends when the helper is killed
risk: a production pattern stopped at its limit asks, one row
